description: This source file implements UCI (Unified Configuration Interface) management functions for a specific application. It includes initialization, accessing, setting, importing/exporting, and managing UCI config sections and options, as well as utilities such as converting string values and iterating over configuration sections. The code interacts with external UCI library functions and manages internal context pointers.

methods.name: char * dmuci_list_to_string(struct uci_list * list,const char * delimitor)
methods.description: Converts a list of UCI element names into a single string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_section_type(const char * package,const char * section,char ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves the type of a specified configuration section.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_option_value_string(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets the value of an option as a string, supporting list options.

methods.name: char * dmuci_get_option_value_fallback_def(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * default_value)
methods.description: Gets the option value as string, or returns default if empty.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_option_value_list(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,struct uci_list ** value)
methods.description: Retrieves an option value as a list of UCI elements.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_value_by_section_string(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets a string value from a specific section option.

methods.name: char * dmuci_get_value_by_section_fallback_def(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,const char * default_value)
methods.description: Gets value from section, or default if not found.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_value_by_section_list(struct uci_section * s,const char * option,struct uci_list ** value)
methods.description: Gets a list of values from a section option.

methods.name: int dmuci_set_value(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific option in a package and section.

methods.name: int dmuci_add_list_value(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Adds a value to a list-type option.

methods.name: int dmuci_del_list_value(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Removes a value from a list-type option.

methods.name: int dmuci_add_section(const char * package,const char * stype,struct uci_section ** s)
methods.description: Creates a new section inside a package.

methods.name: int dmuci_delete(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,const char * value)
methods.description: Deletes a section, option, or package.

methods.name: int dmuci_rename_section(const char * package,const char * section,const char * value)

struct:uci_section * dmuci_walk_section(const char * package,const char * stype,const void * arg1,const void * arg2,int cmp,int (* filter)(struct uci_section * s,const void * value),struct uci_section * prev_section,int walk)
methods.description: Iterates over sections matching certain criteria.

methods.name: struct:uci_section * dmuci_walk_all_sections(const char * package,struct uci_section * prev_section,int walk)
methods.description: Iterates over all sections in a package.

methods.name: int db_get_value_string(const char * package,const char * section,const char * option,char ** value)
methods.description: Gets a string value from database config section.

methods.name: bool dmuci_string_to_boolean(const char * value)
methods.description: Converts string to boolean based on common true values.

methods.name: bool dmuci_is_option_value_empty(struct uci_section * s,const char * option_name)
methods.description: Checks if an option's value is empty.

methods.name: int dmuci_get_section_name(const char * sec_name,char ** value)
methods.description: Converts a section name, possibly hex-encoded, to a string.

methods.name: int dmuci_set_section_name(const char * sec_name,char * str,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a string section name to encoded form if needed.
